{{Short description|Dutch academic}}
'''Bonne Jan "Bob" Wielinga''' (3 October 1945, [[Amsterdam]]<ref>[http://albumacademicum.uva.nl/id/id001202 Prof. dr. B.J. Wielinga, 1945 -] at the [[University of Amsterdam]] ''Album Academicum'' website</ref> – 10 February 2016, Amsterdam) was a Dutch professor at the [[University of Amsterdam]].

Wielinga studied physics at the University of Amsterdam, where he was awarded a PhD in 1972 for a study in nuclear physics. He has performed research on the methodology of [[Knowledge engineering|knowledge-based system design and knowledge acquisition]]. In 1986, Wielinga was appointed full professor of [[Information science|Social Science Informatics]] (SWI) in the Faculty of Psychology. Wielinga leads several research projects, including [[Knowledge Acquisition and Documentation Structuring|KADS]], ACKnowledge, REFLECT and KADS-II and was one of the main contributors to the development of the KADS methodology for knowledge based system development.
